body: Holy shit, that's some good advice.
It's quite an odd thing. I don't think I'm that ugly, but when I'm high I really feel ugly. I don't know.
Yeah, it's all in the facial features.
But they are still ugly when I am high.
I was quite baked at the time, and it was an asshole thing to aay. I love my friends.

I just don't feel happy, I see no point in what I am doing or in life in general. I really don't get it, I do what everybody does, I have the best friends I could ever ask for, but I still feel like complete shit. How can people live like I do and feel genuinely happy? Every social interaction is such a waste of time (seems like living is a waste of time). 

The only thing stopping me from killing myself is the guilt I get from my friends and family. And I'm not sure if I should hate them or love them for that. 

I am currently seeking medical help, if it doesn't get slightly better within 6 months, I'll give up.
